neighbours.label: the first word of the main clause after a comma-closed fronted scope phrase (For X, / In X, / On X, / With X,), strongest when it is 'if' or 'when'
fire: For PDF exports, if the fonts are not embedded the layout may shift.
On shared hosting, when the traffic spikes the site may go offline for a minute.
In primary classrooms, if the group is large, split the activity into two rounds.
With stainless pans, if the oil is not hot enough the fish will stick.
In a biology lab, for example, students often mistake air bubbles for cells.
For compound names, in addition to the main entry, the index lists each part.
On gravel roads, when the surface is loose, brake earlier than you think you need to.
For legacy accounts, if the password was never changed, access is suspended.
quiet: The layout may shift if the fonts are not embedded in a PDF export.
In 2016, the hosting company moved all its servers to Frankfurt.
Split the activity into two rounds if the group in a primary classroom is large.
The fish will stick to a stainless pan if the oil is not hot enough.
Students in a biology lab often mistake air bubbles for cells.
The index lists each part of a compound name after the main entry.
In 2003, when the factory closed, the town lost half its jobs.
Access is suspended for legacy accounts whose password was never changed.
